mapper.select: SELECT v.*, s.id as s_id, s.station_name, s.latitude, s.longitude, s.address, s.capacity, s.available_slots, s.create_time as s_create_time FROM vehicles v LEFT JOIN stations s ON v.current_station_id = s.id

SELECT v.*, s.id as s_id, s.station_name, s.latitude, s.longitude, s.address, s.capacity, s.available_slots, s.create_time as s_create_time FROM vehicles v LEFT JOIN stations s ON v.current_station_id = s.id WHERE v.id = #{id}

SELECT v.*, s.id as s_id, s.station_name, s.latitude, s.longitude, s.address, s.capacity, s.available_slots, s.create_time as s_create_time FROM vehicles v LEFT JOIN stations s ON v.current_station_id = s.id WHERE v.status = #{status}

SELECT v.*, s.id as s_id, s.station_name, s.latitude, s.longitude, s.address, s.capacity, s.available_slots, s.create_time as s_create_time FROM vehicles v LEFT JOIN stations s ON v.current_station_id = s.id WHERE v.current_station_id = #{stationId}
mapper.update: UPDATE vehicles SET vehicle_code = #{vehicleCode}, vehicle_type = #{vehicleType}, status = #{status}, current_station_id = #{currentStationId}, battery_level = #{batteryLevel}, last_maintenance_time = #{lastMaintenanceTime} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE vehicles SET status = #{status}, current_station_id = #{stationId} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE vehicles SET battery_level = #{batteryLevel} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO vehicles (vehicle_code, vehicle_type, status, current_station_id, battery_level, create_time, last_maintenance_time) VALUES (#{vehicleCode}, #{vehicleType}, #{status}, #{currentStationId}, #{batteryLevel}, #{createTime}, #{lastMaintenanceTime})
